title: Make causal settlement skip and refusal recovery tests discriminate production branches
outcome: Settled-row skipping is tested while the authenticated peer remains usable, and refusal-code, connection-change, malformed-receipt and valid-request malformed-settlement paths have behavioral coverage.
acceptance: A settled original is skipped before another relay operation with the peer live, while an otherwise identical unresolved original still issues the read.
Behavioral tests cover write refusal versus pending malformed receipt, frozen connection changes, and malformed settlement on a row with a valid request.
